description: Figure 6(a) illustrates the distribution of self-reflection Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) data statistics across different stages of training. The horizontal axis represents the training stage, labeled with categories: “Initial”, “Stage 1”, “Stage 2”, “Stage 3”, and “Final”, listed in sequential order. The vertical axis represents the number of examples, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 16000, incrementing by 4000.  Five bars are displayed, one for each training stage. The “Initial” stage is represented by a light blue bar with an approximate height of 412. “Stage 1” is represented by a light blue bar with an approximate height of 838. “Stage 2” is represented by a light blue bar with an approximate height of 1022. “Stage 3” is represented by a light blue bar with an approximate height of 1433. The “Final” stage is represented by a light blue bar with an approximate height of 14924. The bars are arranged in ascending order based on their height, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
